evals.prompt: Help us pick a message broker: Kafka (self-managed), Amazon Kinesis, or RabbitMQ. Use case: order-event streaming for a multi-tenant SaaS app at Acme, about 5k events/sec at peak, consumers need replay for up to 7 days, ordering per tenant matters. Hard constraints: we run on AWS, and the platform team is two people with no capacity to run self-hosted clusters on call.
assertions: Uses 8 to 10 criteria spanning capability fit, operational, cost, and risk, and names any criteria deliberately excluded
Shows a 1-5 weight for every criterion with the weight tied in writing to the use case or constraints (e.g. operational burden weighted high because the platform team is two people)
Every score has a one-line justification, and every 5 and every 1 is explained
Totals are computed as sum(weight x score), and a gap under 5% between the top options is called out
Ties are allowed where options genuinely don't differ; scores are not uniformly 3/5
The recommendation is one sentence and says what would change the answer; if it isn't the top scorer, the override is explained
Numbers that are estimates are marked 'rough' or 'directional'; no benchmarks are invented beyond the figures in the prompt
